## Which kind of change is it?

## Checks

- [ ] I have **not** edited any file that begins with `// Auto-generated by ghidra-mcp - DO NOT EDIT`. If I have, I have said why below and understand it will be overwritten at the next regeneration.

- [ ] If this touches `asm_matching/`, I have said what it does to the match figures.
